visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a top-down view of a table scattered with numerous tan Mahjong tiles. Bright, flat indoor lighting illuminates the surface. Large yellow text bubbles and white instructional text overlays are visible, along with animated red envelopes and gold stars that float across the frame. (2) A man wearing an oversized, ruffled red vinyl-style jacket and a thick pink fuzzy head wrap enters from a white-walled hallway. He walks with a rhythmic, exaggerated stride. The camera transitions to a medium shot as he approaches the table, his face showing a serious yet comedic expression. (3) The man begins flipping tiles onto a white paper board that has designated spots for monetary units. The camera uses close-up shots of his hands as he reveals the numbers. He reacts with wide-eyed excitement followed by exaggerated frowns and comedic gestures of despair. (4) In a new phase, the man performs a 'prayer dance' in his red outfit, spinning and waving his arms toward a surveillance camera in the corner. He flips a tile for the 'ten thousand' spot which reveals a non-numeric character, leading to a dramatic collapse where he sits on the floor in mock sadness. (5) A second man in a black fuzzy coat and leopard-print shorts takes a turn, drawing tiles with high energy. The camera captures his laughter in a close-up as confetti graphics shower the screen. (6) The original man returns in a yellow checkered pajama suit, drawing a high score and celebrating with a relieved face. The video concludes with a group of four people—three men and one woman—standing in the room, holding stacks of cash and laughing together.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic beat paired with rapid-fire Mandarin speech explaining game rules. A sharp 'clack' SFX of Mahjong tiles sliding across the table is prominent. (2) A dramatic riser SFX leads into a loud vocal exclamation 'Long zhong deng chang' with high arousal. A comedic synthesizer stinger plays as the character enters. (3) As tiles are flipped, each reveal is punctuated by a 'whoosh' transition and a high-pitched 'ding' sound. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat 4/4 rhythm. (4) A transient 'buzzer' sound effect signals a low-value draw, followed by the man's exaggerated mock-sobbing and overlapping laughter from others in the room. (5) The music shifts to a popular upbeat Chinese pop track with male vocals. The rhythm is highly synchronized with the visual edits. Multiple people cheer loudly, increasing the crowd noise intensity. (6) The final phase features a blend of continuous pop music, celebratory shouting, and the distinct sound of paper currency being snapped. The master track ends with a short, bright melodic stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Round 1 -> Round 2 -> Round 3 -> Comparison -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide high-energy entertainment through a gamified comedy sketch. The video uses the 'luck-of-the-draw' with Mahjong tiles to simulate a year-end bonus, creating humor through the contrast between the main character's initial bad luck and his eventual success compared to others.
